verdict.rationale: Riveter's documentation explicitly serves an OpenAPI spec at https://docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml, with multiple docs entries directly quoting content from that file (riveter-docs-26,27,28,30), indicating a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe only tested .json variants (which 404'd) and never checked the .yaml path, so no contradiction exists. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that the .yaml file is reachable/valid, and no evidence of versioning or spec completeness.
